card.name: Words before a noun in old prose
card.fires_on: No shared pattern; it fires on assorted small words and word parts in older historical or technical prose, such as 'their', 'his', 'the', 'by' and 'and'.

modes.label: Small words in historical prose
modes.description: A pronoun, article or preposition sits just before an expected noun in older narrative text.
